About.title: Reliable Construction & Renovation in Rwanda
About.p1: ECO-STRUCT RWANDA LTD is a Rwanda-based construction and renovation company providing reliable, professional and tailored solutions for residential, commercial, institutional and diplomatic projects.
About.p2: Our expertise covers structural works, renovation, waterproofing, masonry, electrical works, plumbing, roofing, paving, finishing works and general building maintenance.
About.p3: Led by professionals with extensive experience in the construction industry, ECO-STRUCT combines European construction experience with strong knowledge of the Rwandan market.
About.why3: Experience with institutional and diplomatic clients

Services.title: Construction, Renovation & Technical Solutions
Services.subtitle: Comprehensive and professional services for residential, commercial, institutional and diplomatic projects.

Commitment.title: Our Commitments
Commitment.subtitle: We are committed to delivering professional and durable work, with a focus on the values that matter to our clients.
Commitment.qualityDesc: We aim to deliver durable and professional work in accordance with project requirements and good construction practices.
Commitment.safetyDesc: Safety is integrated into the preparation and execution of our construction activities.
Commitment.deadlinesDesc: We organize our teams and resources to respect agreed schedules and minimize disruption to our clients.
Commitment.satisfactionDesc: We prioritize clear communication, responsiveness and practical solutions adapted to each project.

Vision.title: Building a Trusted Construction Partner in Rwanda
Vision.text: Our ambition is to establish ECO-STRUCT RWANDA LTD as a trusted construction partner in Rwanda by delivering high-quality projects, developing long-term client relationships and continuously improving our technical capabilities.

Team.title: Management & Expertise
Team.subtitle: Led by experienced professionals with hands-on expertise across construction and project management.
Team.footer: A growing team — new talents coming soon to serve you better.
Team.founderBio: Extensive hands-on experience in construction, formwork, structural works, team supervision and project management, acquired on major projects in Europe and Rwanda.
Team.japhetBio: Coordinating construction projects, site planning, and quality control across all operations.
Team.gercyBio: Overseeing on-site operations, quality assurance, and technical compliance for all construction projects.
Team.shadrackBio: Driving business development and strategic partnerships.
